name: Raptor Mastery

narrative.details:
So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape?  I can put them to the test in a jiffy.  Head out into that jungle and kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.  We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.

And no, I won't tell you where you can find them!  Locating the beasts is half the challenge.
narrative.objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
narrative.requestItemsText: I never met a hunter who got any kills by standing around the campfire. Were you planning on killing those Stranglethorn Raptors or were you hoping they would die of old age?
